package domain

import (
	"errors"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

const (
	OnboardingPathAdmissionRequestSchema      = "student-onboarding-path-admission-request.v1"
	OnboardingPathAdmissionSchema             = "student-onboarding-path-admission.v1"
	OnboardingPathAdmissionRenewalSchema      = "student-onboarding-path-admission-renewal.v1"
	OnboardingPathMaterializationSchema       = "student-onboarding-path-admission-materialization.v1"
	OnboardingPathMaterializationResultSchema = "student-onboarding-path-materialization.v1"
	OnboardingPathAbortSchema                 = "student-onboarding-path-admission-abort.v1"
)

type OnboardingPathAdmissionStatus string

const (
	OnboardingPathAdmissionReserved     OnboardingPathAdmissionStatus = "RESERVED"
	OnboardingPathAdmissionMaterialized OnboardingPathAdmissionStatus = "MATERIALIZED"
	OnboardingPathAdmissionAborted      OnboardingPathAdmissionStatus = "ABORTED"
)

type OnboardingPathGoal struct {
	Code         string `json:"code"`
	Version      string `json:"version"`
	GraphVersion string `json:"graph_version"`
}
type OnboardingPathAdmission struct {
	Schema          string                           `json:"schema"`
	AdmissionID     string                           `json:"admission_id"`
	StudentID       string                           `json:"student_id"`
	HandoffID       string                           `json:"handoff_id"`
	ExecutionID     string                           `json:"execution_id"`
	StateRef        StudentPlanningReadinessStateRef `json:"state_ref"`
	Goal            OnboardingPathGoal               `json:"goal"`
	Status          OnboardingPathAdmissionStatus    `json:"status"`
	Fence           int64                            `json:"fence"`
	ExpiresAt       time.Time                        `json:"expires_at"`
	Replayed        bool                             `json:"replayed"`
	CourseID        string                           `json:"-"`
	AssignmentID    string                           `json:"-"`
	LearningPathID  string                           `json:"-"`
	RequestHash     string                           `json:"-"`
	MaterializeHash string                           `json:"-"`
	AbortHash       string                           `json:"-"`
}
type OnboardingPathAdmissionRequest struct {
	Schema           string                           `json:"schema"`
	HandoffID        string                           `json:"handoff_id"`
	ExecutionID      string                           `json:"execution_id"`
	ExpectedStateRef StudentPlanningReadinessStateRef `json:"expected_state_ref"`
	Goal             OnboardingPathGoal               `json:"goal"`
}
type OnboardingPathLessonBinding struct {
	LessonRevisionID string              `json:"lesson_revision_id,omitempty"`
	Item             LearningPathItem    `json:"-"`
	LessonID         string              `json:"lesson_id"`
	Targets          []LearningTargetRef `json:"targets"`
}
type OnboardingPathCourseBinding struct {
	CourseID             string `json:"course_id"`
	CourseFingerprint    string `json:"course_fingerprint"`
	PlannerPolicyVersion string `json:"planner_policy_version"`
	ReasonCode           string `json:"reason_code"`
	ReasonSummary        string `json:"reason_summary"`
}
type OnboardingPathMaterialization struct {
	Schema      string                        `json:"schema"`
	ExecutionID string                        `json:"execution_id"`
	Fence       int64                         `json:"fence"`
	Course      OnboardingPathCourseBinding   `json:"course"`
	Lessons     []OnboardingPathLessonBinding `json:"lessons"`
}
type OnboardingPathMaterializationResult struct {
	Schema              string                        `json:"schema"`
	AdmissionID         string                        `json:"admission_id"`
	Status              OnboardingPathAdmissionStatus `json:"status"`
	CourseID            string                        `json:"course_id"`
	AssignmentID        string                        `json:"assignment_id"`
	LearningPathID      string                        `json:"learning_path_id"`
	FirstLessonID       string                        `json:"first_lesson_id"`
	LearningPathVersion int64                         `json:"learning_path_version"`
	JourneyVersion      int64                         `json:"journey_version"`
	Replayed            bool                          `json:"replayed"`
}
type OnboardingPathAbort struct {
	Schema      string `json:"schema"`
	ExecutionID string `json:"execution_id"`
	Fence       int64  `json:"fence"`
	Reason      string `json:"reason"`
}
type OnboardingPathAdmissionRenewal struct {
	Schema      string `json:"schema"`
	ExecutionID string `json:"execution_id"`
	Fence       int64  `json:"fence"`
}

func NormalizeOnboardingPathAdmissionRequest(v OnboardingPathAdmissionRequest) (OnboardingPathAdmissionRequest, error) {
	v.Schema = strings.TrimSpace(v.Schema)
	v.HandoffID = strings.TrimSpace(v.HandoffID)
	v.ExecutionID = strings.TrimSpace(v.ExecutionID)
	v.Goal.Code = strings.TrimSpace(v.Goal.Code)
	v.Goal.Version = strings.TrimSpace(v.Goal.Version)
	v.Goal.GraphVersion = strings.TrimSpace(v.Goal.GraphVersion)
	if v.Schema != OnboardingPathAdmissionRequestSchema || !canonicalAdmissionUUID(v.HandoffID) || !canonicalAdmissionUUID(v.ExecutionID) || !validAdmissionState(v.ExpectedStateRef) || !validAdmissionGoal(v.Goal) {
		return v, ErrValidation
	}
	return v, nil
}
func NormalizeOnboardingPathMaterialization(v OnboardingPathMaterialization) (OnboardingPathMaterialization, error) {
	v.Schema = strings.TrimSpace(v.Schema)
	v.ExecutionID = strings.TrimSpace(v.ExecutionID)
	v.Course.CourseID = strings.TrimSpace(v.Course.CourseID)
	v.Course.CourseFingerprint = strings.TrimSpace(v.Course.CourseFingerprint)
	v.Course.PlannerPolicyVersion = strings.TrimSpace(v.Course.PlannerPolicyVersion)
	v.Course.ReasonCode = strings.TrimSpace(v.Course.ReasonCode)
	v.Course.ReasonSummary = strings.TrimSpace(v.Course.ReasonSummary)
	if v.Schema != OnboardingPathMaterializationSchema || !canonicalAdmissionUUID(v.ExecutionID) || !canonicalAdmissionUUID(v.Course.CourseID) || v.Fence < 1 || v.Course.CourseFingerprint == "" || len(v.Course.CourseFingerprint) > 128 || v.Course.PlannerPolicyVersion == "" || len(v.Course.PlannerPolicyVersion) > 64 || v.Course.ReasonCode == "" || len(v.Course.ReasonCode) > 64 || v.Course.ReasonSummary == "" || len(v.Course.ReasonSummary) > 500 || len(v.Lessons) < 1 || len(v.Lessons) > 500 {
		return v, ErrValidation
	}
	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(v.Lessons))
	for i := range v.Lessons {
		v.Lessons[i].LessonID = strings.TrimSpace(v.Lessons[i].LessonID)
		if !canonicalAdmissionUUID(v.Lessons[i].LessonID) || (v.Lessons[i].LessonRevisionID != "" && !canonicalAdmissionUUID(v.Lessons[i].LessonRevisionID)) {
			return v, ErrValidation
		}
		if _, exists := seen[v.Lessons[i].LessonID]; exists && v.Lessons[i].LessonRevisionID == "" {
			return v, ErrValidation
		}
		seen[v.Lessons[i].LessonID] = struct{}{}
		targets, err := NormalizeLearningTargetRefs(v.Lessons[i].Targets)
		if err != nil {
			return v, ErrValidation
		}
		v.Lessons[i].Targets = targets
	}
	return v, nil
}
func NormalizeOnboardingPathAdmissionRenewal(v OnboardingPathAdmissionRenewal) (OnboardingPathAdmissionRenewal, error) {
	v.Schema = strings.TrimSpace(v.Schema)
	v.ExecutionID = strings.TrimSpace(v.ExecutionID)
	if v.Schema != OnboardingPathAdmissionRenewalSchema || !canonicalAdmissionUUID(v.ExecutionID) || v.Fence < 1 {
		return v, ErrValidation
	}
	return v, nil
}
func NormalizeOnboardingPathAbort(v OnboardingPathAbort) (OnboardingPathAbort, error) {
	v.Schema = strings.TrimSpace(v.Schema)
	v.ExecutionID = strings.TrimSpace(v.ExecutionID)
	v.Reason = strings.TrimSpace(v.Reason)
	if v.Schema != OnboardingPathAbortSchema || !canonicalAdmissionUUID(v.ExecutionID) || v.Fence < 1 || (v.Reason != "NO_GAP" && v.Reason != "STATE_CHANGED" && v.Reason != "ACTIVE_PATH_EXISTS" && v.Reason != "CANCELLED") {
		return v, ErrValidation
	}
	return v, nil
}
func canonicalAdmissionUUID(s string) bool { u, e := uuid.Parse(s); return e == nil && u.String() == s }
func validAdmissionState(v StudentPlanningReadinessStateRef) bool {
	return (v.Kind == "accepted_draft" || v.Kind == "finalized_profile") && v.Version >= 1
}
func validAdmissionGoal(v OnboardingPathGoal) bool {
	return v.Code != "" && len(v.Code) <= 64 && v.Version != "" && len(v.Version) <= 64 && v.GraphVersion != "" && len(v.GraphVersion) <= 128
}
func (v OnboardingPathAdmission) Validate() error {
	if v.Schema != OnboardingPathAdmissionSchema || !canonicalAdmissionUUID(v.AdmissionID) || !canonicalAdmissionUUID(v.StudentID) || !canonicalAdmissionUUID(v.HandoffID) || !canonicalAdmissionUUID(v.ExecutionID) || !validAdmissionState(v.StateRef) || !validAdmissionGoal(v.Goal) || v.Fence < 1 || v.ExpiresAt.IsZero() || (v.Status != OnboardingPathAdmissionReserved && v.Status != OnboardingPathAdmissionMaterialized && v.Status != OnboardingPathAdmissionAborted) {
		return errors.New("invalid onboarding path admission")
	}
	return nil
}
